dcterms:description: A dataset consisting of 12,045 records of adult deaths collected through verbal autopsies in India, coded by physicians with ICD-10 codes grouped into 18 cause-of-death categories.
dcterms:title: Million Death Study (MDS)

dcterms:description: A dataset containing Indian English text from the International Corpus of English and 1.7 million posts from MedHelp, used to enhance the training of word embeddings.
dcterms:title: International Corpus of English and MedHelp Posts
